conformal: P95/P99 of actual/forecast 7-day ratios, past 26 weeks, >= 8 weeks required; separate for weeks touching a holiday (any day within 3 days before one) and quiet weeks

models.seasonal_mean_4w: mean of the same weekday over the last 4 weeks
models.lgb_level: global LightGBM on rupees (current approach, as in run_rolling_origin.py)
models.lgb_holiday: lgb_level plus holiday family, next holiday, bank-closure run and last year's lift for the same holiday
models.lgb_ratio: global LightGBM on demand / trailing 28-day mean, recency-weighted
models.blend: mean of lgb_ratio, lgb_level and seasonal_mean_4w
